div.head: Grið 15
div.ab: 7 se þe in cynges byrig oððon on his neaweste feohteð oððe steleð, he bið feorhscyldig, nimþe se cyng alyfan wille, þæt man wergy[lde] alysan mote.
And se þe in cynges byrig oððon on his neaweste feohteð oððe steleð, he bið feorhscyldig, nimþe se cyng alyfan wille þæt man wergylde alysan mote.
Und wer in des Königs Burg oder in seiner Nähe ficht oder stiehlt, der ist das Leben [zu verlieren] schuldig, wenn nicht der König gestatten will, dass [er] durch Wergeld ausgelöst werden dürfe.
And whoever fights or steals in the king's stronghold or in his vicinity is liable [to lose] his life, unless the king will allow that [he] may be redeemed by wergild.
And anyone who fights or steals in the king’s compound or in his vicinity is to be condemned to death, unless the king permits that he may be redeemed with his wergild.
div.note: There is a hole in G after ‘wergy’; ‘[lde]’ is supplied. K's ‘þat’ is corrected to ‘þæt’ and a line break removed.; T: corrected against Rabin, DOML 66 (2020), p. 24 (before: ‘And se þe in cynges byrig oððon on his neaweste feohteð oððe steleð, he bið feorhscyldig, nimþe se cyng alyfan wille þat man wergylde alysan mote.’)
